extracted.name: Smoked salmon tartines
extracted.description: Grow primroses from January to April and use the flowers to make a delicious topping for these sourdough tartines. They make a lovely light lunch, starter or canapé
ingredient_lines: 4 slices of rye or sourdough bread
8-10 organic primrose flowers (primula vulgaris) or other edible flowers
instruction_lines: Toast the bread, then spread with the crème fraîche. Flake the smoked salmon over the top and garnish with the capers, gherkin and a squeeze of lemon juice. Season, then scatter over the chopped chives and primrose flowers (see tip, below).
